verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own features act on many items at once. A single plan/apply builds a graph of all resources and parallelizes non-dependent creates and modifications. Destroy mode tears down all remote objects in one plan. for_each generates provider configurations in bulk, and a community report describes for_each on import blocks for mass imports. Module versions can be updated across a codebase with one variable change, and -exclude scopes bulk runs. missing for 10: first-party documentation of for_each/count for bulk resource creation, documented bulk import beyond a community mention, hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk runs.
